planned_required.scenario: Integration: three distinct mention cases — @user user_ids+matrix.to pill, literal @room m.mentions.room=true, and #room matrix.to room pill without m.mentions.room.
preconditions: alice and bob joined to room R
bob user id known
a mentionable room id/alias available for #room autocomplete
composer supports UserMentionAutocomplete (@user and literal @room) and RoomMentionAutocomplete (#room)
trigger_actions: CASE 1 (@user): In RoomInput, type @ and select bob via UserMentionAutocomplete (createMentionElement for user MXID). Send; capture event content.
CASE 2 (literal @room): In RoomInput, insert the literal @room editor mention node (UserMentionAutocomplete path with name "@room" / getMentions node.name === "@room"). Send; capture event content.
CASE 3 (#room): In RoomInput, type # and select a room via RoomMentionAutocomplete (createMentionElement for room id/alias). Send; capture event content.
Confirm timeline renders mention pills/links appropriate to each case (user pill, @room room-mention presentation, #room room pill).
assertions: CASE 1 (@user): content["m.mentions"] from getMentionContent includes user_ids containing bob’s MXID; m.mentions.room is not true for a pure user mention; body/formatted_body includes the user matrix.to pill serialization (https://matrix.to/#/<userId> href) from editor Mention output — not a bare unrelated string.
CASE 2 (literal @room): content["m.mentions"].room === true. This is the only case among the three that may set m.mentions.room=true (getMentions sets room only when node.name === "@room").

planned_required.scenario: Integration: four currently supported distinct media sends (file/image/video/audio) plus fail-closed true Matrix voice-message gate requiring literal org.matrix.msc3245.voice, org.matrix.msc1767.audio (duration+waveform), and ordinary m.audio playback content.
preconditions: alice in R with send permission
fixtures: sample.bin (file), sample.png (image), sample.mp4 (video), sample.ogg or .mp3 (ordinary audio)
product voice-message composer path under test for the fail-closed voice case (or documented absence)
trigger_actions: IMAGE: Attach/send sample.png; assert getImageMsgContent path → msgtype m.image with url/file and info.mimetype/size.
VIDEO: Attach/send sample.mp4; assert getVideoMsgContent path → msgtype m.video with media info.
AUDIO (ordinary): Attach/send sample audio file; assert getAudioMsgContent path → msgtype m.audio with filename, body, info.mimetype, info.size only (url or encrypted file block).
FILE: Attach/send sample.bin; assert getFileMsgContent path → msgtype m.file with filename, body, info.mimetype, info.size.

VOICE (true Matrix voice message, separate from ordinary audio): Exercise the product true voice-message send path. Assert the event content includes all of: (1) literal key org.matrix.msc3245.voice whose value is an empty object {}; (2) literal key org.matrix.msc1767.audio whose value is an object containing duration and waveform data; (3) ordinary m.audio media content needed for playback (msgtype m.audio with body/filename/info and url or encrypted file). If either literal marker/audio-metadata block is absent or malformed, or if the product only has getAudioMsgContent ordinary m.audio, this step FAILS under GATE-7.4-005-VOICE-MESSAGE—do not skip, do not accept renamed markers, and do not pass merely because ordinary audio plays.
Do not exercise sticker/GIF-only shortcuts as substitutes for the four supported media types or the voice gate.
assertions: Image event msgtype is m.image with MXC url or encrypted file block and image info fields.
Video event msgtype is m.video with media info fields.
Ordinary audio event msgtype is m.audio with filename/body and info.mimetype/size from getAudioMsgContent; it must not be accepted as a true voice message solely because it is m.audio and playable.
File event msgtype is m.file with filename/body and info.mimetype/size from getFileMsgContent.
Four currently supported distinct sends appear in the room timeline: file, image, video, ordinary audio.

True voice-message case: event content MUST carry (1) literal org.matrix.msc3245.voice empty-object marker; (2) literal org.matrix.msc1767.audio block with duration and waveform data; (3) ordinary m.audio media content needed for playback. The suite FAILS if either literal org.matrix.msc3245.voice or org.matrix.msc1767.audio is absent or malformed, if a renamed substitute is used, or if only ordinary getAudioMsgContent m.audio is present. GATE-7.4-005-VOICE-MESSAGE remains blocking—playable ordinary audio is not a pass for the voice clause.

planned_required.scenario: Integration: independent poll start, poll response, structured Hermes agent-card, and dangerous-command approval-prompt paths; all four positive cases required to pass.
preconditions: alice,bob in R
polls enabled in composer
structured Hermes agent payload fixture under a configured/default content key (org.hermes.agent, io.hermes.agent, or in.synara.agent)
dangerous-command approval-prompt body fixture recognizable by detectAgentApprovalPrompt
separate malformed structured Hermes payload fixture
separate malformed/non-approval body fixture
trigger_actions: POLL START (independent): alice creates poll via RoomInput poll UI; assert mx.sendEvent with POLL_START_EVENT_TYPE (org.matrix.msc3381.poll.start) content including question and answers.
POLL RESPONSE (independent): bob votes via PollContent; assert mx.sendEvent with POLL_RESPONSE_EVENT_TYPE (org.matrix.msc3381.poll.response) referencing the poll event id and selected answer ids.

STRUCTURED HERMES AGENT CARD (independent): inject/receive a timeline message whose content includes a valid structured Hermes agent payload under a configured/default content key (org.hermes.agent, io.hermes.agent, or in.synara.agent). Assert parseHermesAgentPayload returns a payload and RenderMessageContent renders HermesAgentCard (not ordinary text-only).

DANGEROUS-COMMAND APPROVAL PROMPT (independent): inject/receive a timeline message whose body is a dangerous-command approval prompt. Assert detectAgentApprovalPrompt returns an AgentApprovalPrompt, RenderMessageContent renders AgentApprovalCard, and production approval planning/notification behavior (agentApprovals helpers / ClientNonUIFeatures AgentApprovalNotifications) can plan/notify for that event.
NEGATIVE structured Hermes: inject a malformed structured Hermes payload; parseHermesAgentPayload rejects or falls back safely (no HermesAgentCard for invalid structured content).
NEGATIVE approval prompt: inject a malformed/non-approval body; detectAgentApprovalPrompt returns undefined and does not open AgentApprovalCard for that body.

PASS RULE: requirement pass requires poll start AND poll response AND structured Hermes agent card AND approval prompt ALL to pass. One custom-agent path must not substitute for the other; neither custom-agent path may substitute for polls.
Do not treat raw REST /messages scraping as a valid implementation or verification route; agent events already in the timeline must be recognized via the production parsers/renderers.
assertions: Poll start event type is POLL_START_EVENT_TYPE with question and answers content.
Poll response event type is POLL_RESPONSE_EVENT_TYPE referencing poll event id and selected answer ids.
Structured Hermes path: parseHermesAgentPayload succeeds for configured/default keys (org.hermes.agent, io.hermes.agent, in.synara.agent) and HermesAgentCard is rendered.
Approval-prompt path: detectAgentApprovalPrompt succeeds and AgentApprovalCard is rendered, with approval planning/notification behavior supported as in production.
Malformed structured Hermes payload is rejected/falls back safely (no false HermesAgentCard).
Malformed approval prompt is rejected/falls back safely (no false AgentApprovalCard).
All four positive independent cases must pass; no poll-versus-agent alternative and no approval-versus-Hermes alternative; one path does not satisfy another.
Recognition uses production timeline content parsers/renderers; raw /messages scraping is not a valid route.
planned_required.test_target: RoomInput poll start, PollContent vote, parseHermesAgentPayload/HermesAgentCard, detectAgentApprovalPrompt/AgentApprovalCard + approval notification planning

trigger_actions: Start upload of large file via composer upload board (useBindUploadAtom.startUpload → uploadContent).
While status===UploadStatus.Loading, sample progress.loaded/progress.total updates (throttled onProgress).
Call cancelUpload while Loading; assert mx.cancelUpload(promise) path runs and board does not transition that item to Success.
Force an upload Error status; invoke startUpload again on the same card (retry); assert a new Loading→Success (or Error) cycle with a new promise.
Read aggregate board state: Idle/Loading/Success/Error across items (UploadBoard isError / per-card status).
assertions: Queue/item status is exactly one of UploadStatus Idle|Loading|Success|Error for each tracked file atom.
During Loading, progress.total equals file.size and progress.loaded is monotonic non-decreasing until Success/Error/cancel.
After cancelUpload on Loading, the item is not Success with an mxc for that cancelled promise.
After Error, retry startUpload sets Loading again with a new promise; onSuccess sets Success with mxc string; onError sets Error with MatrixError.
UI board reflects Error when any upload.status===Error and clears when retries succeed.

planned_required.scenario: Integration: all 22 Command enum entries succeed on valid payloads/preconditions via RoomInput special paths or useCommands exe; unknown commands and invalid payloads are separate negatives that must not mutate state.
preconditions: alice admin in R where moderation commands require power
bob user id available for invite/kick/ban/ignore/startdm targets
second joinable room id/alias
disposable room for leave/ACL/membership experiments
valid fixtures for ACL flags, poll command payload, room nick, mxc avatar, delete past window, and events to redact
RoomInput composer path available so /me /notice /shrug /tableflip /unflip exercise integrated send (not useCommands no-op exe alone)
trigger_actions: Enumerate all 22 product Command enum entries (me, notice, shrug, tableflip, unflip, startdm, join, leave, invite, disinvite, kick, ban, unban, ignore, unignore, myroomnick, myroomavatar, converttodm, converttoroom, delete, acl, poll). Assert each is registered in useCommands with name/description/exe.
ROOMINPUT COMPOSER SPECIAL PATHS (do not require useCommands no-op exe functions to create side effects; validate the integrated RoomInput submit path):
VALID /me with text body: RoomInput sets msgtype m.emote (MsgType.Emote) and sends the message body.
VALID /notice with text body: RoomInput sets msgtype m.notice (MsgType.Notice) and sends the message body.
VALID /shrug with optional text: RoomInput prefixes body/html with the exact SHRUG constant then sends as an ordinary message.
VALID /tableflip with optional text: RoomInput prefixes body/html with the exact TABLEFLIP constant then sends.
VALID /unflip with optional text: RoomInput prefixes body/html with the exact UNFLIP constant then sends.
useCommands VALID PATHS (valid payload/precondition required; documented successful effect required — a validation error does not pass a valid-path case):
VALID /startdm with valid userId: creates DM (createRoom is_direct) or navigates existing DM for that user.
VALID /join with valid room id/alias: mx.joinRoom joins the room.
VALID /leave with empty payload leaves current room, or with room ids leaves listed rooms via mx.leave.
VALID /invite with valid userIds: mx.invite each listed user (optional -r reason).
VALID /disinvite with valid userIds: mx.kick as disinvite path for each listed user.
VALID /kick with valid users/servers: mx.kick with reason/server expansion as implemented.
VALID /ban with valid users/servers: mx.ban with reason/server expansion as implemented.
VALID /unban with valid userIds: mx.unban listed users.
VALID /ignore with valid userIds: mx.setIgnoredUsers adds those users.
VALID /unignore with valid userIds: mx.setIgnoredUsers removes those users.
VALID /myroomnick with non-empty nick: sendStateEvent room member state updates displayname.
VALID /myroomavatar with valid mxc:// URL: sendStateEvent room member state updates avatar_url.
VALID /converttodm: addRoomIdToMDirect marks room as DM.
VALID /converttoroom: removeRoomIdFromMDirect removes DM mark.
VALID /delete with valid past window and targets: redactEvent path redacts matching events.
VALID /acl with valid allow/deny flags: sendStateEvent m.room.server_acl content updates ACL.
VALID /poll with valid parseable poll command payload: sendEvent POLL_START_EVENT_TYPE with poll start content from makePollStartContentFromCommand.
NEGATIVE unknown command: submit an unknown slash token; existing autocomplete/error/no-execution behavior; no random command executes; room/account state unchanged by that token.

NEGATIVE invalid/missing payloads: for commands that require payload, exercise invalid/missing inputs; existing validation/error/no-execution behavior; no room/account state mutation from the invalid attempt. These negatives do not satisfy any valid-path acceptance clause.
assertions: All 22 Command enum entries are registered in useCommands return map with name/description/exe; none skipped or renamed.
VALID /me: RoomInput integrated path sends m.emote with the emote body (useCommands Me exe remains a no-op and is not the success oracle).
VALID /notice: RoomInput integrated path sends m.notice.
VALID /shrug, /tableflip, /unflip: RoomInput integrated path sends a message with the exact SHRUG/TABLEFLIP/UNFLIP prefix transformation.

VALID paths for the remaining 17 commands each produce their documented successful effect (DM create/navigate, join, leave, invite, disinvite/kick, ban, unban, ignore list mutate, unignore, member nick, member avatar, convert to DM, convert to room, redact, ACL state, poll start).
No valid-path case may pass by showing a validation error, silent no-op, or swallowed unawaited failure.
Unknown command negative: no product command executed; no room/account state mutation.
Invalid/missing payload negatives: existing validation/error/no-execution behavior; no room/account state mutation; do not satisfy any valid-path clause.
planned_required.test_target: RoomInput integrated special composer paths + useCommands CommandRecord exhaustive valid-path integration with separate invalid/unknown negatives

preconditions: instrumented media cache directory path used by the desktop media pipeline
ability to load N large media items exceeding the configured bound B

If no media disk cache with bound B exists yet, this test FAILS and GATE-7.5-004-MEDIA-CACHE-BOUND remains blocking—recording the gap is not a pass.
planned_required.test_target: media cache integration (fail closed) + boundedLru unit as non-sufficient helper only

current_behavior_and_limits.notes: Evidence (conservative): (1) `downloadMedia` in synara/src/app/utils/matrix.ts performs fetch and returns only `res.blob()` — HTTP response headers are discarded; the function neither surfaces nor parses Content-Disposition. (2) The product carries upload MIME/name metadata via mx.uploadContent name/type/includeFilename options and Matrix event fields info.mimetype, info.size, plus body/filename (msgContent builders). Those product/event metadata fields are distinct from HTTP response headers and must not be treated as Content-Disposition evidence. (3) FileHeader/FileContent pass the product/event filename into savePlatformFile → saveDesktopFile; native Rust `sanitize_download_filename` in src-tauri/src/desktop_file_transfer.rs sanitizes that supplied name (basename extraction; control chars and path separators replaced). Native sanitization is product-side bridge evidence, not a P0.1 matrix-js-sdk import ledger row. The current product does not parse, use, or sanitize a response Content-Disposition header.
current_behavior_and_limits.limits: P0.1 method candidates are AST name hits, not type-checked receiver proofs. Upload MIME/name metadata, event info.mimetype/size/body/filename, and native sanitization of the supplied event/product filename must not be counted as Content-Disposition header handling. GATE-7.5-008-CONTENT-DISPOSITION-BOUNDARY remains open until an independent adversarial response Content-Disposition case is proven: an unsafe disposition filename with traversal/path-separators/control characters must not override the event/product filename or escape native saving. Event/product-filename sanitization alone does not close the Content-Disposition gate.

planned_required.phase: Phase 7 — Media pipeline
planned_required.scenario: Integration: MIME type, filename, size, and content-disposition safety on media upload/download — requires BOTH independent cases: (a) adversarial response Content-Disposition cannot override event/product filename or escape native saving, and (b) unsafe event/product filename sanitized at the native bridge. One case must not substitute for the other.
preconditions: file with known MIME type and known byte size
CASE A fixture: media HTTP response supplies a literal adversarial Content-Disposition filename with traversal/path-separators/control characters that differs from the event/product filename
CASE B fixture: event/product filename itself is unsafe (traversal/path-separators/control characters) and is the name passed to savePlatformFile
download/save path through FileHeader/media boundary and savePlatformFile → native desktop_save_file / sanitize_download_filename
trigger_actions: Upload via matrix uploadContent / RoomInput with name, type, includeFilename options; capture outbound upload metadata (MIME/name).
Send as m.file/m.image and assert content.info.mimetype, content.info.size, and content.filename/body as product/event metadata (distinct from HTTP response headers).

CASE A (response Content-Disposition boundary — independent of CASE B): Download/save when the media HTTP response carries a literal adversarial unsafe Content-Disposition filename (traversal segments, path separators, control characters) that differs from the event/product filename. Assert the disposition filename does not override the event/product filename used for save, does not escape native saving, and is not adopted as the on-disk name. Current downloadMedia returns only a Blob and discards headers (neither surfaces nor parses Content-Disposition); this case must still be asserted fail-closed under GATE-7.5-008-CONTENT-DISPOSITION-BOUNDARY — do not skip, do not make the check conditional on disposition presence alone, and do not accept CASE B event-filename sanitization as a substitute pass for CASE A.

CASE B (event/product filename native sanitization — independent of CASE A): Download/save with an unsafe event/product filename (traversal/path-separators/control characters) passed to savePlatformFile/FileHeader; assert native Rust sanitize_download_filename sanitizes the supplied name so the saved path is basename-safe. CASE B must not substitute for CASE A.
Assert saved payload size matches the downloaded file byte length.
assertions: Upload options include intended MIME type matching file.type (or sanitized safe MIME).
Event content.info.size equals file byte length.
Product/event filename and info.mimetype/size are present as event metadata and are distinct from HTTP Content-Disposition response headers.

CASE A: a literal adversarial unsafe response Content-Disposition filename cannot override the event/product filename or escape native saving. If the product still discards headers without a proven Content-Disposition boundary, the suite FAILS under GATE-7.5-008-CONTENT-DISPOSITION-BOUNDARY. Event/product-filename sanitization alone is not a pass for CASE A.

CASE B: an unsafe event/product filename is sanitized at the native bridge (sanitize_download_filename) so the on-disk name has no traversal/path-separators/control characters. CASE B does not substitute for CASE A.
Saved size matches payload length.
planned_required.test_target: matrix uploadContent options, msgContent info.mimetype/size/body/filename, downloadMedia Blob-only (no Content-Disposition parse), savePlatformFile + native sanitize_download_filename; GATE-7.5-008-CONTENT-DISPOSITION-BOUNDARY

current_behavior_and_limits.summary: Current desktop partially implements create room, create DM, join by ID, join by alias, leave, invite, kick, ban, and unban via 30 production matrix-js-sdk-related file(s); status=partial because the product has no user-facing actual forget operation and no outsider knock request plus authorized admission/resolution flow.
current_behavior_and_limits.notes: Evidence (conservative): Supported product flows present today: create room (CreateRoom / create-room utils mx.createRoom), create DM (CreateChat / createRoom is_direct), join by id and join by alias (mx.joinRoom and getRoomIdForAlias), leave (LeaveRoomPrompt / LeaveSpacePrompt / useCommands / Invites mx.leave), invite (InviteUserPrompt / useCommands mx.invite), kick, ban, and unban (UserModeration and /kick /ban /unban command paths via mx.kick / mx.ban / mx.unban). Two independent absent product flows: (1) FORGET — no user-facing product forget control that calls the actual forget operation and removes a previously left room from the known-room list; leave is not forget. (2) KNOCK — no outsider membership knock request issued through product controls, exposed to an authorized user, and admitted/resolved through actual product controls. Membership.Knock types, join-rule knock/knock_restricted configuration (CreateRoom/RoomJoinRules/JoinRulesSwitcher), invitations, leave, fixtures, helper-only paths, configuration-only paths, and raw HTTP are not substitutes for either absent flow. GATE-7.6-001-FORGET and GATE-7.6-001-KNOCK are independent mandatory gates; neither substitutes for the other.
current_behavior_and_limits.limits: P0.1 method candidates are AST name hits, not type-checked receiver proofs. Do not count leave as forget. Do not count Membership.Knock, join-rule configuration, invite, leave, fixtures/types, helper-only, configuration-only, or raw HTTP as knock request+admit. Both absent flows remain open under GATE-7.6-001-FORGET and GATE-7.6-001-KNOCK until the actual product operations exist and pass planned AT/MA independently.

planned_required.scenario: Integration: create room, create DM, join by id, join by alias, leave, invite, kick, ban, unban, plus independent mandatory FORGET and KNOCK clauses. Both absent clauses must be asserted; neither substitutes for the other. Leave, join-rule configuration, invite, Membership.Knock type, fixtures, helper-only, configuration-only, and raw HTTP never satisfy the forget clause and never satisfy the knock clause.
preconditions: alice,bob accounts
joinable room id and alias
admin power for moderation
CASE FORGET fixture: a previously left room still present in alice's known-room list until forgotten
CASE KNOCK fixture: knock join_rule room, outsider account, authorized admitter (alice)
trigger_actions: CREATE ROOM: alice creates a non-DM room via CreateRoom/createRoom util; assert room id returned and joined.
CREATE DM: alice creates/opens DM with bob (CreateChat or /startdm createRoom is_direct); assert DM room and m.direct association.
JOIN BY ID: alice joins !room:server via joinRoom(roomId).
JOIN BY ALIAS: alice joins #alias:server via joinRoom(alias) (and getRoomIdForAlias path where used).
INVITE: alice invites bob (InviteUserPrompt / mx.invite); bob sees invite.
KICK: alice kicks bob (members UI or /kick); bob membership leave/kick.
BAN: alice bans bob; membership ban.
UNBAN: alice unbans bob; ban cleared.
LEAVE: alice leaves a disposable room via LeaveRoomPrompt (mx.leave). Leave alone is not forget and does not satisfy GATE-7.6-001-FORGET.

CASE FORGET (independent of KNOCK): after leave, alice forgets that previously left room via the actual product forget operation (must invoke the real forget API path — not leave, not a substitute operation, not helper-only, not configuration-only, not raw HTTP). Assert the room is removed from alice's known-room list. If the product has no forget control/API, assertion fails under GATE-7.6-001-FORGET — do not pass, do not skip, do not accept leave as forget.

CASE KNOCK (independent of FORGET): an outsider issues an actual membership knock against a knock join_rule room through product controls; the knock is exposed to an authorized user (alice); alice admits/resolves the knock through actual product controls. Do not accept Membership.Knock type alone, join-rule configuration alone, invite used as a stand-in, leave, fixtures, helper-only, configuration-only, or raw HTTP. If request, expose, or admit/resolve is missing, assertion fails under GATE-7.6-001-KNOCK — do not pass, do not skip.
assertions: Create room yields a joined room with expected name/visibility preset.
Create DM yields a direct room with bob invited/joined per preset.
Join by id membership is join for that room id.
Join by alias membership is join for resolved room.
Invite creates invite membership for bob.
Kick removes bob’s join membership.
Ban sets bob membership to ban.
Unban clears ban allowing re-join/invite.
Leave sets alice membership to leave and is not a forget of the room from the known-room list.

CASE FORGET: the actual product forget operation is invoked and the previously left room is removed from alice’s known-room list. Leave, helpers, configuration, fixtures, substitute operations, or raw HTTP are not a pass. Missing forget fails closed under GATE-7.6-001-FORGET.

CASE KNOCK: outsider membership knock is issued, exposed to an authorized user, and admitted/resolved through actual product controls. Membership.Knock type, join-rule configuration, invite, leave, fixtures, helper-only, configuration-only, or raw HTTP are not a pass. Missing knock fails closed under GATE-7.6-001-KNOCK. CASE FORGET and CASE KNOCK are both mandatory and neither substitutes for the other.

current_behavior_and_limits.summary: Current desktop partially implements room-upgrade UI and predecessor/successor navigation controls via 1 production matrix-js-sdk-related file(s); status=partial because exact product UI execution of the supported upgrade request, proven successor creation/usability, proven predecessor/successor event/state linkage, and both navigation directions are not established — helper-only authedRequest or 'may use POST /upgrade' wording must not pass acceptance.
current_behavior_and_limits.notes: Evidence (conservative): Product UI source-links (not runtime proof): (1) Upgrade write path is RoomUpgradeDialog in synara/src/app/features/common-settings/general/RoomUpgrade.tsx:61-70 — mx.http.authedRequest(Method.Post, `/rooms/${room.roomId}/upgrade`, undefined, { new_version, additional_creators? }). This is the product call site inside the Upgrade dialog opened from the RoomUpgrade tile, not a free-standing helper definition or uninvoked component. (2) UI entry mounts: room-settings/general/General.tsx:63 and space-settings/general/General.tsx:59 mount <RoomUpgrade /> under Advanced Options; permission gate is permissions.stateEvent(StateEvent.RoomTombstone / m.room.tombstone, mx.getSafeUserId()). (3) Successor navigation owners: RoomUpgrade reads m.room.tombstone.replacement_room and offers Open New Room/Space via navigateRoom/navigateSpace; RoomTombstone (RoomView/Space composer replacement) offers Join New Room (mx.joinRoom) / Open New Room. (4) Predecessor navigation owners: RoomUpgrade reads m.room.create predecessor.room_id and offers Old Room/Space; RoomIntro also navigates to predecessor.room_id. (5) P0.1 AST candidates on RoomUpgrade.tsx are only getSafeUserId/isSpaceRoom — authedRequest is not an AST method candidate and must not be invented as one. Exact product UI execution of the upgrade request, proven successor creation/usability, proven predecessor/successor event/state linkage, and both navigation directions are not established by existing automated tests or closed acceptance. Helper-only authedRequest capability, direct raw HTTP harnesses, fixtures, renamed/equivalent routes, or uninvoked components never prove the requirement. GATE-7.6-003-ROOM-UPGRADE-PRODUCT-FLOW remains open. Rust cutover for the upgrade write path requires Matrix Rust SDK typed room-upgrade request support as a non-substitutable cutover requirement — not raw HTTP tracked for later. Mapped SC-020/SC-045 cover room model and join-by-id only; they do not prove a typed upgrade write API.

planned_required.scenario: Integration: real product administrator room-upgrade flow issues the exact supported upgrade request, creates a usable successor with predecessor/successor state linkage, and navigates both directions through product UI. Helper-only authedRequest, renamed/equivalent routes, fixtures, or uninvoked components never pass. Rust cutover requires Matrix Rust SDK typed room-upgrade request support (non-substitutable; not raw HTTP tracked for later).
preconditions: admin alice with m.room.tombstone permission on disposable upgradable room Old
capabilities m.room_versions available for version selection
product UI path: room settings → General → Advanced Options → RoomUpgrade (not a helper-only harness)
trigger_actions: As admin alice, open Old room settings → General → Advanced Options → RoomUpgrade; open the Upgrade dialog and complete Upgrade Room through the product control.

Assert the product issues the exact supported room-upgrade request: authenticated POST to path `/rooms/{Old.roomId}/upgrade` with JSON body including `new_version` set to the selected room version (and `additional_creators` only when the selected version supports creators). Fail if a raw-helper-only path, a renamed/equivalent route, a fixture, or any uninvoked component is used instead of the product RoomUpgrade control.
After success, assert successor room New exists and is usable (joinable/openable); assert Old has m.room.tombstone with replacement_room=New; assert New's m.room.create predecessor.room_id=Old.
From Old (RoomUpgrade Open New Room and/or RoomTombstone Open/Join New Room), navigate to New through product UI.
From New (RoomUpgrade Old Room and/or RoomIntro predecessor control), navigate back to Old through product UI.
assertions: The upgrade was initiated only through the product administrator RoomUpgrade UI; helper-only authedRequest, direct raw HTTP harnesses, renamed/equivalent routes, fixtures, or uninvoked components are a FAIL under GATE-7.6-003-ROOM-UPGRADE-PRODUCT-FLOW.
The issued request is exactly POST `/rooms/{Old.roomId}/upgrade` with body `new_version` (and optional `additional_creators` only when applicable). Renamed or substitute routes fail closed.
Successor New exists and is usable after upgrade.
Predecessor/successor event/state linkage: Old m.room.tombstone.replacement_room == New; New m.room.create.predecessor.room_id == Old.
Both navigation directions work through product UI: Old → New (successor) and New → Old (predecessor).

Matrix Rust SDK cutover for the upgrade write path requires typed room-upgrade request support as a non-substitutable cutover requirement. Raw HTTP must not be accepted as the post-cutover route and must not be recorded as merely 'tracked for later'.
planned_required.test_target: RoomUpgrade product UI (room-settings/space-settings General Advanced Options); successor RoomTombstone/RoomUpgrade nav; predecessor RoomUpgrade/RoomIntro; GATE-7.6-003-ROOM-UPGRADE-PRODUCT-FLOW

current_behavior_and_limits.summary: Current desktop partially implements schema versioning, unknown-field preservation, and shared-contract fixture validation via 7 production matrix-js-sdk-related file(s) and desktop contract tests that read the canonical fixtures under synara/docs/contracts/fixtures/; status=partial because the iOS client does not consume those canonical fixture JSON files — iOS contract tests embed separate string literals, and string coincidence / similarly shaped fixtures / generated copies must not pass as canonical fixture consumption.
current_behavior_and_limits.notes: Evidence (conservative): (1) Canonical fixture source of truth is synara/docs/contracts/fixtures/*.json (schemas under synara/docs/contracts/). (2) Desktop consumption is proven: synara/src/app/contracts/__tests__/contractSchemas.test.ts reads those JSON files via readFileSync (e.g. docs/contracts/fixtures/synara-later-content.json, synara-room-notes-content.json, synara-unread-anchor-content.json, synara-spaces-content.json, agent/route/notification/settings fixtures) and validates against schemas; later.ts/roomNotes.ts normalize paths enforce versioning and documented unknown-field rules. (3) iOS does not read/parse/import the canonical fixture JSON at runtime or build time for the shared contract suite: synara-ios/SynaraTests/SynaraContractsTests.swift embeds private multiline string literals (validLaterContentJSON, validNotificationSummaryJSON, validAgentCardJSON, and peers) decoded via JSONDecoder — no Data(contentsOf:) of the fixture paths, no Bundle resource of those files, no build-phase copy of the canonical inventory. (4) Narrow exception only: AgentApprovalServiceTests.loadSharedAgentApprovalFixture loads synara-agent-approval-action.json via a repository-relative path; that one helper does not constitute iOS consumption of the full canonical fixture inventory and does not close this gate. (5) String coincidence between iOS literals and fixture values (e.g. !room:example.org, version:1, similar item shapes) is distinct evidence and does not satisfy canonical fixture consumption. GATE-7.7-009-IOS-CANONICAL-FIXTURE-CONSUMPTION remains open until an iOS client run that changes/loads the actual canonical fixture files proves observed values originate from those files.
current_behavior_and_limits.limits: P0.1 method candidates are AST name hits, not type-checked receiver proofs. Do not treat embedded string literals, duplicated/renamed/manually copied fixtures, similarly shaped local JSON, or generated copies as iOS canonical fixture consumption. Desktop schema validation of the shared files alone does not prove iOS fixture compatibility. GATE-7.7-009-IOS-CANONICAL-FIXTURE-CONSUMPTION remains open.

DESKTOP CANONICAL FIXTURE CONSUMPTION (source-proven): Run contractSchemas.test.ts reading the actual files under synara/docs/contracts/fixtures/ via readFileSync; assert Later, room notes, unread anchors, spaces, routes, notification summary, room-event anchors, agent action/card/approval, settings fixtures pass schema validation. Desktop acceptance fails if tests stop reading those canonical paths.

iOS CANONICAL FIXTURE CONSUMPTION (GATE-7.7-009-IOS-CANONICAL-FIXTURE-CONSUMPTION): On an iOS client/XCTest run, load the same canonical fixture JSON files from synara/docs/contracts/fixtures/ (not embedded string literals). Mutate a unique sentinel value in a canonical fixture file, re-run the iOS consumer, and assert the observed decoded values match the mutated canonical file. Fail if the iOS path uses only private string literals (as in SynaraContractsTests.swift validLaterContentJSON and peers), a duplicated/renamed/manually copied fixture, a similarly shaped local JSON, or a generated copy that is not the canonical path.

NEGATIVE (iOS provenance): With iOS still on string-literal-only fixtures, a change to the canonical file must not be treated as a pass — either iOS values stay stale while the suite still claims compatibility, or the suite never loads the canonical path; both fail closed under GATE-7.7-009-IOS-CANONICAL-FIXTURE-CONSUMPTION. planned_required.scenario: Integration-e2e against disposable Synapse with two clients/sessions: (A) inbound self-device verification request is queued by ensureVerificationRequestInbox (CryptoEvent.VerificationRequestReceived, early-install before startClient) and presented by ReceiveSelfDeviceVerification; (B) outbound Verify from Another Device uses requestOwnUserVerification and Verify on other device uses requestDeviceVerification, each opening DeviceVerification; (C) SAS emoji ceremony progresses Requested→Ready→Started with ShowSas emoji compare (confirm match completes Done; mismatch/cancel yields Cancelled) including accept/startVerification(Sas)/verifier.verify/request.cancel paths. After cutover P8.3 same observables via Rust GAP-SAS-VERIFICATION / SC-084 shapes + product inbox ownership + IPC DTO; SC-084 alone, compile-only blocked, raw /_matrix HTTP, dual-backend, trust-badge-only (FR-7.9-004), device-list-only (FR-7.9-003), bootstrap-only (FR-7.9-002), or helper/fixture-only FAIL.
planned_required.test_target: verificationRequestInbox (VerificationRequestReceived + hydrate/dismiss) + ReceiveSelfDeviceVerification + DeviceVerification SAS ceremony + Verification.tsx requestOwnUserVerification/requestDeviceVerification; post-cutover GAP-SAS-VERIFICATION/SC-084 under P8.3
preconditions: Disposable Synapse; two desktop sessions for the same Matrix user (device A and device B) with E2EE/crypto initialized; cross-signing active so Devices verification tiles are shown (Enable path is FR-7.9-002).

Named product surfaces present: verificationRequestInbox.ts, DeviceVerification.tsx (ceremony + ReceiveSelfDeviceVerification), Verification.tsx VerifyCurrentDeviceTile/VerifyOtherDeviceTile, useVerificationRequest.ts, verification.ts; Router mounts ReceiveSelfDeviceVerification.

Harness can observe Device Verification dialog phases (Accept / Waiting / emoji compare / Done / Cancelled), inbox presentation without process restart, and does not bypass product inbox or ceremony with dual-backend/raw HTTP/helper-only pass criteria.
Optional: in-progress request hydrate via getVerificationRequestsToDeviceInProgress when UI mounts after request already exists.
trigger_actions: Boot integration harness against disposable Synapse with two same-user sessions. Do not use fixture-only mocks that skip product inbox/ceremony, dual-backend selectors, raw HTTP, or helper-only pass criteria.

INBOUND INBOX: From device A start verification toward B (or B starts own-user verification so A receives to-device request). On receiving device assert ensureVerificationRequestInbox queued the self-verification request (VerificationRequestReceived) and ReceiveSelfDeviceVerification shows Device Verification dialog without requiring Settings navigation. Confirm early-install path: request received around first sync is not dropped before UI subscribe; hydrate in-progress requests on mount.
OUTBOUND OWN: On unverified current device open Settings → Devices → Verify from Another Device (requestOwnUserVerification). Assert DeviceVerification opens; other verified device can accept.
OUTBOUND OTHER: From verified current device on OtherDevices Unverified tile press Verify (requestDeviceVerification). Assert DeviceVerification opens for that deviceId.

SAS CEREMONY COMPLETE: Progress phases — Requested (Accept on inbound or wait on initiator), Ready (startVerification Sas on initiator), Started (emoji list via ShowSas/getShowSasCallbacks). Press They Match on both sides; assert Done «Your device is verified» and exit dismisses/clears ceremony UI. Optionally assert subsequent trust display (FR-7.9-004) but do not use badge alone as pass.
SAS CANCEL/MISMATCH: Repeat with Do not Match or dialog close cancel (request.cancel when non-terminal); assert Cancelled UI and request leaves active queue (dismiss on exit).

After cutover P8.3, repeat inbound inbox, outbound starts, complete, and cancel observables via Rust verification request/SAS APIs under product lifecycle actor/IPC DTOs. Citing SC-084 alone, GAP compile-only, raw /_matrix HTTP, dual-backend/SDK selector, trust-badge-only, device-list-only, bootstrap-only, or helper/fixture-only is a FAIL.
assertions: INBOX: inbound self-verification requests appear via verificationRequestInbox (VerificationRequestReceived + optional getVerificationRequestsToDeviceInProgress hydrate) and ReceiveSelfDeviceVerification without dropping early first-sync requests.
OUTBOUND: requestOwnUserVerification and requestDeviceVerification open DeviceVerification ceremony UI.
SAS COMPLETE: phase machine reaches Done after emoji confirm on both sides (accept/startVerification/verify/ShowSas confirm).
SAS CANCEL: cancel or mismatch yields Cancelled; non-terminal exit calls request.cancel before dismiss.
COORDINATION: inbox + ceremony state remain through verificationRequestInbox / DeviceVerification (or Rust/IPC successors), not ad-hoc dual writers.
CUTOVER: P8.3 preserves inbox+ceremony observables via Rust ownership + IPC DTO; SC-084/GAP compile-only never product pass; no raw /_matrix runtime HTTP; no dual-backend/SDK selector.
No new production matrix-js-sdk usage and no raw /_matrix runtime HTTP unless the dossier marks that exact behavior typed-sdk-request-required.

Trust badge/status alone (FR-7.9-004), device list alone (FR-7.9-003), bootstrapCrossSigning alone (FR-7.9-002), unused ShowReciprocateQr, and helper unit tests alone are not accepted as sole pass criteria for this FR.

RECOVERY SETUP + KEY: On session without recovery, open Settings → Devices → Enable. Complete SetupVerification (optional passphrase). Assert createRecoveryKeyFromPassphrase → bootstrapSecretStorage(setupNew) → resetKeyBackup path; RecoveryKeyDisplay shows key; exercise Show, Copy, Download.

BACKUP ENABLEMENT: After setup, open Devices with Verified current device; assert Encryption Backup tile Connected (or transitions to Connected) via getActiveSessionBackupVersion / KeyBackupStatus; Backup Details version/count populated when available.

RECOVERY UNLOCK + RESTORE: On a second session (or after clearing local backup keys), use Verify Manually with recovery key (or passphrase). Assert checkKey success, loadSessionBackupPrivateKeyFromSecretStorage, then Restore Backup and/or auto-restore on KeyBackupDecryptionKeyCached with Fetching/Loading progress to Done.

REPAIR: From Devices options open Reset Device Verification; assert permanent-reset warning; complete re-setup producing new recovery key and resetKeyBackup. ENABLEMENT: Encryption Backup status reflects active session backup version (Connected) after enablement; status updates via KeyBackupStatus without requiring process restart.
UNLOCK: Manual recovery key/passphrase validates via checkKey; loadSessionBackupPrivateKeyFromSecretStorage succeeds.
RESTORE: manual restoreKeyBackup and/or auto-restore on KeyBackupDecryptionKeyCached reports progress through backupRestoreProgressAtom stages to Done (or product-equivalent success).
REPAIR: DeviceVerificationReset re-setup path and/or trust/sync diagnostics are observable; no requirement for a separate Repair Backup button label.
COORDINATION: restore progress remains through backupRestoreProgressAtom (or Rust/IPC successor); secret-storage key cache through secretStorageKeys (or successor), not ad-hoc dual writers.

CUTOVER: P8.5 preserves setup/key/enablement/restore/repair observables via Rust ownership + IPC DTO; SC-065/SC-066/GAP compile-only never product pass; no raw /_matrix runtime HTTP; no dual-backend/SDK selector.

VIDEO: Attach/send sample.mp4; assert getVideoMsgContent path → msgtype m.video with media info.

FILE: Attach/send sample.bin; assert getFileMsgContent path → msgtype m.file with filename, body, info.mimetype, info.size.

Assert the event content includes all of: (1) literal key org.matrix.msc3245.voice whose value is an empty object {}; (2) literal key org.matrix.msc1767.audio whose value is an object containing duration and waveform data; (3) ordinary m.audio media content needed for playback (msgtype m.audio with body/filename/info and url or encrypted file). Recognition uses production timeline content parsers/renderers; raw /messages scraping is not a valid route.

planned_required.scenario: Integration: create room, create DM, join by id, join by alias, leave, invite, kick, ban, unban, plus independent mandatory FORGET and KNOCK clauses. Both absent clauses must be asserted; neither substitutes for the other. Leave, join-rule configuration, invite, Membership.Knock type, fixtures, helper-only, configuration-only, and raw HTTP never satisfy the forget clause and never satisfy the knock clause.
preconditions: alice,bob accounts
joinable room id and alias
admin power for moderation
CASE FORGET fixture: a previously left room still present in alice's known-room list until forgotten
CASE KNOCK fixture: knock join_rule room, outsider account, authorized admitter (alice)
trigger_actions: CREATE ROOM: alice creates a non-DM room via CreateRoom/createRoom util; assert room id returned and joined.
CREATE DM: alice creates/opens DM with bob (CreateChat or /startdm createRoom is_direct); assert DM room and m.direct association.
JOIN BY ID: alice joins !room:server via joinRoom(roomId).
JOIN BY ALIAS: alice joins #alias:server via joinRoom(alias) (and getRoomIdForAlias path where used).
INVITE: alice invites bob (InviteUserPrompt / mx.invite); bob sees invite.
KICK: alice kicks bob (members UI or /kick); bob membership leave/kick.
BAN: alice bans bob; membership ban.
UNBAN: alice unbans bob; ban cleared.
LEAVE: alice leaves a disposable room via LeaveRoomPrompt (mx.leave). Leave alone is not forget and does not satisfy GATE-7.6-001-FORGET.

CASE FORGET (independent of KNOCK): after leave, alice forgets that previously left room via the actual product forget operation (must invoke the real forget API path — not leave, not a substitute operation, not helper-only, not configuration-only, not raw HTTP). Assert the room is removed from alice's known-room list. If the product has no forget control/API, assertion fails under GATE-7.6-001-FORGET — do not pass, do not skip, do not accept leave as forget.

CASE KNOCK (independent of FORGET): an outsider issues an actual membership knock against a knock join_rule room through product controls; the knock is exposed to an authorized user (alice); alice admits/resolves the knock through actual product controls. Do not accept Membership.Knock type alone, join-rule configuration alone, invite used as a stand-in, leave, fixtures, helper-only, configuration-only, or raw HTTP. If request, expose, or admit/resolve is missing, assertion fails under GATE-7.6-001-KNOCK — do not pass, do not skip.
assertions: Create room yields a joined room with expected name/visibility preset.
Create DM yields a direct room with bob invited/joined per preset.
Join by id membership is join for that room id.
Join by alias membership is join for resolved room.
Invite creates invite membership for bob.
Kick removes bob’s join membership.
Ban sets bob membership to ban.
Unban clears ban allowing re-join/invite.
Leave sets alice membership to leave and is not a forget of the room from the known-room list.

CASE FORGET: the actual product forget operation is invoked and the previously left room is removed from alice’s known-room list. Leave, helpers, configuration, fixtures, substitute operations, or raw HTTP are not a pass. Missing forget fails closed under GATE-7.6-001-FORGET.

CASE KNOCK: outsider membership knock is issued, exposed to an authorized user, and admitted/resolved through actual product controls. Membership.Knock type, join-rule configuration, invite, leave, fixtures, helper-only, configuration-only, or raw HTTP are not a pass. Missing knock fails closed under GATE-7.6-001-KNOCK. CASE FORGET and CASE KNOCK are both mandatory and neither substitutes for the other.
planned_required.test_target: CreateRoom/CreateChat/Invite/Leave/join/moderation; GATE-7.6-001-FORGET (actual forget + remove previously-left room from known-room list); GATE-7.6-001-KNOCK (outsider knock + authorized expose + product admit/resolve)
